text:
elaine.p: Marketplace request: propose a "reserved consumption floor" SKU bundled with partner HW to lower sticker shock and improve renewals. Ideas?

mike.sales: Prefer a min-commit floor (12mo) at a ~60% list price with rollover/overage credits rather than steep upfront discounts. Keeps ARR tidy.

anya.prod: Agree but require onboarding credits + SI milestones so customers see value before renewal.

-suresh.si: SI can run a 90-day ramp: deploy, tune, knowledge transfer. Need an SKU to attach service credits (e.g., HW-BNDL-PRIME = 4 deploy days + 8 tuning days).

mike.sales: Renewal incentive: extra 3% off if they renew before month 9 and commit 10% uplift. Good signal for upsell.

liam.legal: Legal note: conditioned discounts must be in SOW, recommend non-refundable portion of floor, define downgrade/escape path.

anya.prod: Productize two SKUs: Starter Reserved (lower floor) and Enterprise Reserved (higher floor + SI + co-marketing).

deploy-bot: snapshot: pilot interest = 8 leads, region preference us-west-2, avg 2-4 GPUs. link: https://go.redwood/marketplace-pilot

elaine.p: Action items: mike -> pricing grid + renewal cadence; anya -> package SKUs; suresh -> 90-day SI playbook; liam -> term sheet language. Sync Thurs 11am PT.

mike.sales: Add HW delay clause: pro-rata credits if delivery delayed >30d.

liam.legal: I'll include cap and remediation steps in term sheet.

elaine.p: Great, thanks all.
